msg: context fabric resolution trace: alias lookup
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on deps.AliasLookup != nil, which no production composition root sets today.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: anchor kind withheld
bounded_aggregation: bounded per request_id call by len(admission.withheldSubjects()) -- self-carried index/total, cross-checked against AnchorKindWithheldSummary's own anchor_kind_withheld count.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: anchor kind withheld summary
context fabric resolution trace: anchor offer
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call -- anchorOfferMaterial's own single call site.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: anchor pool kind scope
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call -- emitted from the same statement that hands the scope to the confirmed-kind filter.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: anchor slot displaced
bounded_aggregation: present iff this pass's RankedCutSummary line reports anchor_slot_displaced > 0 -- the two lines' counts must agree; today at most one candidate can be displaced per pass (kindReserveSlotsPerKind), so at most one line.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: confirmed kind rescue
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on confirmedKindRescueAttempted (this event's own PRESENCE already means the rescue was attempted); CertifyAbsent asserts the case where it never ran.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: confirmed kind scope
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on confirmedKind != nil && resolution-wide searchTruncated && nothing committed yet (CHAOS-4039 requires it stay structurally unreachable otherwise); CertifyAbsent asserts the case where it never fires.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: corroboration
bounded_aggregation: bounded by this pass's own candidate-set size -- Total on every line is that size, matching CorroborationSummary's own candidate_count for the SAME pass (same underlying slice, no intervening append/removal).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: corroboration summary
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per corroboration pass -- the per-candidate detail this summary aggregates stays at Debug (Corroboration above).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: decision
bounded_aggregation: bounded by the pass's own outcome: one line per committed subject for a "committed" pass (self-carried index/total), otherwise exactly one line (index=1/total=1) -- never zero.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: decision summary
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call, emitted from decisionSummaryBuffer.flush() unconditionally (including a zero count) -- the per-candidate decision events this line folds stay at Debug (case "decision").

msg: context fabric resolution trace: evidence census commit
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- mergeCensusAttestedSatisfier's own single, unlooped call site, gated on the evidence round naming an attested satisfier; CertifyAbsent asserts the (far more common) case where it never runs.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: evidence probe (shadow census)
bounded_aggregation: bounded per resolveSubjects call by len(a.Kinds), the SAME count EvidenceRound's own shadow_kinds_censused reports for the same call -- self-carried index/total.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: evidence round (shadow)
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on deps.CensusFunc != nil and the stalled-resolution precondition (nothing committed, resolution-wide searchTruncated); CertifyAbsent asserts the (far more common) case where it never runs.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: evidence source native (shadow widening)
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- the SAME gating EvidenceRound's own call site carries (traceSourceNativeBinds is called from inside RunShadowEvidenceRound, past the same axis/scope gates); CertifyAbsent asserts the case where the round never reaches that point.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: evidence source native probe (shadow widening)
bounded_aggregation: bounded per resolveSubjects call by len(binds), the SAME count EvidenceSourceNative's own source_native_match_count reports for the same call -- self-carried index/total.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: exact name search
bounded_aggregation: bounded per (request_id, term_hash) call -- self-carried index/total, never accumulated across the multiple calls one resolution can make.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: identity gate
bounded_aggregation: bounded per resolveSubjects call by however many isAliasLookupScopedKind candidates NodeCandidate builds across BOTH its own call sites -- self-carried index/total, stamped at identityGateSummaryBuffer.flush() once that total is known, matching IdentityGateSummary's own candidate_count for the same call.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: identity gate summary
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- withheld entirely when no alias-lookup-scoped candidate reached the gate; CertifyAbsent asserts that case.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: identity universe read
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on the SAME AliasLookup wiring/temporal-axis condition AliasLookup's own event fires under, plus the identity-universe read itself running.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: kind coverage floor
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: kind hint search
bounded_aggregation: bounded per (request_id, term_hash, queried_kind) call -- self-carried index/total, never accumulated across the multiple calls one resolution can make.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: kind offer
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call -- kindOfferMaterial/candidateOfferMaterial/handleOfferMaterial's own unconditional call site, folded (CHAOS-5636) so an early return upstream cannot skip it.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: kind offer withheld
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- emitted only when the offer withheld at least one frame-declared kind; CertifyAbsent asserts the (far more common) case where it never fires.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: low population kind scope
bounded_aggregation: bounded per resolveSubjects call by len(chaos4417LowPopulationScopedKinds), a fixed constant known before the loop starts -- self-carried index/total, cross-checked against no sibling summary count (the summary shares no field with the detail line; see LowPopulationKindScopeSummary's own doc comment for why the two were split onto distinct Msg strings).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: low population kind scope summary
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per resolveSubjects call, emitted via a plain deferred statement inside applyLowPopulationKindOffers -- including the vector-configured early return.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: offer pool
bounded_aggregation: bounded by this pass's own combined vector_only_demoted + vector_only_excluded count -- Total on every line is that sum, matching OfferPoolSummary's own two fields for the SAME pass.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: offer pool summary
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per pass, emitted unconditionally (including explicit zeros on the early-return empty-graph path) -- the per-candidate detail this summary aggregates stays at Debug (OfferPool above).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: ranked cut summary
bounded_aggregation: exactly one line per ranked-cut pass -- the per-candidate detail this summary aggregates stays at Debug (case "ranked_cut", RankedCutSummary==false).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: reserved kind admitted
bounded_aggregation: bounded by this pass's own reserve-admission count (self-carried index/total) -- 0 on the common path where the reserve never fires; no sibling summary event exists for this stage.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: search
bounded_aggregation: bounded by resolveSubjects' own terms list length for this call -- Total on every line is that length, Index is this line's 1-based position in the loop that produced it.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: search question
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- gated on deps.SearchQuestion != nil and a non-empty question; CertifyAbsent asserts the (far more common) case where the backend does not implement it.

msg: context fabric resolution trace: slice b survivor verdict
bounded_aggregation: bounded per resolveSubjects call by len(ordered), the SAME count SliceBSurvivorVerdictSummary's own candidate_count reports for the same call -- self-carried index/total; zero lines whenever attestation.Reason == ReasonBudgetExhausted (the function's own early return before either loop runs).

msg: context fabric resolution trace: slice b survivor verdict summary
bounded_aggregation: at most one line per resolveSubjects call -- withheld entirely when SurvivorsFirstOrder's own candidate list is empty; CertifyAbsent asserts that case.
